system.description:
• Twinned Spell: a spell that targets only one creature and allows a save or needs a touch attack can target a second creature in range with the same casting; each is affected as normal. Enhanced: a third creature as well.
  • Careful Spell: up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) creatures you choose automatically succeed on their save against the spell. Enhanced: they take no effect at all.
  • Empowered Spell: reroll up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) damage dice and keep the new results. Enhanced: reroll any number of the damage dice and keep the new results.
  • Extended Spell: double the duration. Enhanced: triple it, to a maximum of 24 hours.
  • Heightened Spell: one target has Disadvantage on its first save against the spell. Enhanced: all targets do. Against a kill effect, once per encounter.
  • Distant Spell: double the range; touch spells extend to 30ft, and an unwilling target still needs the touch attack. Enhanced: triple the range; touch extends to 60ft.
  • Subtle Spell: cast with no words or gestures; no one can tell you cast it. Enhanced: it also cannot be counterspelled.
  • Flexible Spell: freely change the damage type of the spell to any other type. Enhanced: it also ignores resistance to the new type.
  • Quickened Spell: cast the spell and one cantrip with the same action; no other spell can be cast that turn (the Fey-touched Awakening's extra spell aside). It has no enhanced effect: a Wild Surge gives its base effect.
